title: A Development Set's expectations: .private/work/walk-expect/<set>.json
description: The limits scripts/walk/verdict.py judges a walk's checks by (docs/specs/factory.md 5 'G1'): from Q5's limits and the Answer Key's counts, never from a walk's own recording; prepared by drawing-analyst, reviewed by qs-critic, the counts confirmed by the owner; never in git. A missing key makes its check UNSET, and UNSET fails PASS: files for reads_complete; p95_ms_max for act_p95_during_read; the last three, all of them, for questions_per_discipline.

files.description: How many files the set holds; every one must be read.

p95_ms_max.description: The act p95 limit, in ms, while a later file reads.

bulk_confirmable_share_min.description: Q5: the share of a Discipline's Sheets the QS can confirm in bulk.

false_continuation_max.description: Q5: continuation Questions that are not continuations.
